text:
Anna: Heads up — planning a short Launch Gate prep (go/no-go) to decide the cut for v1.8. Target cut date: 2026-11-12. Proposed window: Fri 9:00–9:30 PT. Quick agenda below. Please drop availability and any must-have agenda items.

Mike: I can join but only until 9:20 PT. Can we prioritize DB migration checkpoint first? :thumbsup:

Sasha: +1 for migration first. Also need a final sign-off on canary plan. I'll add notes.

Jordan: Out Friday AM for training. I can join the 9:30 slot if we shift 30m later. Otherwise I'll async review notes.

Liz: I can do 9:00. Can someone add the QA smoke checklist to agenda? We had flaky tests last run.

Kevin: I'm in. Also request: we need to confirm rollback playbook owner — tagging @sre oncall? @deploy-bot any way to get oncall listed?

deploy-bot: calendar link: <https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/12345|Launch Gate: Nov 12 - go/no-go> — RSVP here. Oncall: @sre-oncall is scheduled Fri 08:00–20:00 PT.

Anna: thanks. Here's a trimmed agenda — 20 minutes decision, 10 minutes action items. Paste this into the calendar invite:
```
1) Quick status (infra/migrations/canary) — 8m
2) QA smoke & test blockers — 6m
3) Rollback & oncall assignment — 4m
4) Decision: GO / HOLD / ROLLBACK — 2m
5) Owners & follow-ups — 10m (if GO)
```

Mike: can we add a preread link? i'll drop deploy runbook + migration notes here: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/launch/migration

Sasha: preread acked. I also attach the canary metric dashboard in the invite (link added).

Anna: Updated the invite to 9:00–9:30 PT and included preread links. Current RSVP: Mike, Liz, Kevin, Sasha, Anna. Jordan - marked as maybe. Please react with :eyes: when you've reviewed preread.

Liz: :eyes:

Jordan: marking :white_check_mark: — I'll review notes async and ping if blockers.

Kevin: :thumbsup: I'll own rollback playbook if we need one. Will add to invite notes.

Anna: Great — if no major objections by EOD PST, we'll lock the gate and treat Friday meeting as final decision. Thanks all.
